verdict.rationale: Square provides extensive first-party docs for card, ACH, Cash App, Afterpay payments, plus sandbox testing and idempotency guidance, and the Node.js/TypeScript SDK shows concrete copy-paste code (client.payments.create). This supports fast integration, but the evidence pack shows only one language's SDK example, no explicit 'under a day' quickstart guide, and no cross-language parity proof (Python, Java, PHP, etc.) or independent developer testimony confirming a same-day integration timeline. missing for 10: multi-language copy-paste examples, an explicit time-to-integrate quickstart, independent hands-on confirmation of a sub-day integration.
